description: Fetches one result file of a finished separation (GET /stem-tool/jobs/{id}/files/{name}): a stem (vocals, instrumental, drums, bass, other, depending on the number of stems chosen; .mp3, or .flac when the job has format "flac") or all of them as stems.zip. By default the file is downloaded and its local path is returned; with download=false only the signed link is returned, valid for about 60 seconds. Files are kept 24 hours after the separation (410 afterwards); the job must be in state "done" (409 otherwise). Costs no quota (read rate limit).

download.description: true (default): download to a local file and return its path. false: return only the short-lived signed URL.

name.description: File to fetch. A name not produced by this job (e.g. drums.mp3 after a 2-stem separation, or a .mp3 name for a FLAC job) answers 404.

name: jj_stems_get_file
title: Get a separated stem
